summary: A collection of TypeScript projects that help developers quickly build deployable applications using the Claude API.
usecases: Prototype AI chatbot or assistant features in web or mobile apps
Integrate Claude language capabilities into existing software products for rapid testing
Create proof‑of‑concept demos for AI‑driven content generation
ideas: Combine the quickstart projects with static site generators to build AI‑enhanced blogs
Develop a CLI tool that uses Claude to generate code snippets or documentation automatically
Integrate the projects into CI/CD pipelines to automatically test AI responses in build steps
